title: Onboard vector-encoder-v2 + pairwise-reranker into catalog with pinned-versioning and automated profile publish
creator: Priya Kapoor
description:
Summary:
We need to onboard a new vector encoder (vector-encoder-v2) and a pairwise re-ranker (pairwise-reranker-v1) into the Redwood model catalog. This ticket covers artifact validation, pinned-versioning semantics, automated performance-profile generation, and publishing the profile to the catalog + console. Goal is a safe canary rollout with deterministic performance profiles so downstream customers can pin to exact model versions with known latency/cost/quality trade-offs.

Why this work:
- vector-encoder-v2 improves average embedding quality by ~8% on internal similarity evals but has a different memory/latency profile that needs calibrated batching and quantization recommendations.
- pairwise-reranker-v1 reduces false positives on re-rank sets but is sensitive to sequence length and KV cache behavior.
- We must produce and publish versioned performance profiles to enable safe pinning and automated routing/fallbacks in production.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Artifacts validated in the onboarding pipeline (checksum, schema, tokenizer compatibility).
2) A pinned catalog entry exists for both models (e.g., vector-encoder-v2@2026-02-01-1, pairwise-reranker-v1@2026-02-01-1) and is visible in the Console model catalog.
3) Automated perf profile created and attached to the pinned entry: latency P50/P95/P99 for typ. batch sizes, throughput (tokens/sec and vectors/sec), memory footprint, recommended quantization profile, and suggested batching policy.
4) Canary rollout configured: 5% traffic for 48h with automatic rollback on latency regressions or quality drops flagged by eval harness.
5) E2E smoke tests pass (SDK generate/embeddings + rerank pipeline) and GitHub PRs merged for onboarding + Console UI bits.
6) Docs: Confluence onboarding page and Drive artifact links created and referenced.

Plan / Steps:
- Step 1: Artifact upload & validation (ENG infra + model ops) — checksum, tokenizer, model graph compatibility.
- Step 2: Offline evals and quality gating (Research) — run standard similarity sets and pairwise ranking testbeds.
- Step 3: Performance benchmarking (bench infra) — latency sweep across seq lengths, batch sizes, and token lengths; capture KV cache behavior and steady-state throughput.
- Step 4: Generate profile JSON with recommended default_batch_size, quantization recommendation, and buckets for latency/throughput; store in model-catalog service.
- Step 5: Pin new version and create a canary rollout policy in Console; wire up alerting and tracing hooks.
- Step 6: Publish profile and notify SDK/Docs that pinned version is available.

Trade-offs & Decisions:
- We are prioritizing pinned versions (immutable profile) over continuous floating tags to avoid surprising regressions for customers.
- For initial launch we recommend q4.0 quantization for vector-encoder-v2 only when customers select Dedicated or Private due to observed accuracy degradation in hosted low-memory configs.
- We choose 5% canary for 48h to balance exposure and ramp; this can be tightened if infra risks increase.

Monitoring & Metrics:
- Latency: P50/P95/P99 per route and per model-version.
- Throughput: embeddings/sec and reranks/sec.
- Error rates: generation/embedding failures, OOMs.
- Quality: rolling eval on held-out prompt sets; automated alerts if embedding cosine drift > 0.03 or reranker MRR drop > 2%.
- Dashboards: Grafana panel linked below.

Artifacts & Links:
- Confluence onboarding spec: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/MODELS/Onboarding+vector-encoder-v2+and+pairwise-reranker
- Design doc (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cOnboardDocs
- Onboarding test harness (GitHub): https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-onboarding/tree/ENG-15840
- Perf benchmark job: https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks/pull/289
- Model catalog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/1145
- Console change PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/762
- Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ML/models-performance-overview

Rollout notes:
- Create pinned catalog entries with start_date and immutable profile URL.
- Canary only allowed for hosted tier initially; Dedicated customers will be able to opt in via console flag.
- If canary triggers rollback, the profile publish is reverted and incident runbook ENG-INV-09 is followed.

Risks:
- Vector-encoder-v2 has higher memory pressure under long sequence benchmarks; need to validate autoscaler policies for Dedicated.
- Pairwise reranker may regress on niche query distributions; require extra eval sets from PM-reported customers.

Next steps (owner: Liam O'Connor):
- Finish artifact validation scripts (due 2026-02-12).
- Run perf benchmark sweep and attach profile JSON to catalog (due 2026-02-20).
- Open canary config and Console PR for visibility (due 2026-02-26).
